prompt: Tailor my resume for this TELUS Digital posting — Senior Manager, Solutions Architecture - Data & AI (Remote, US). The full posting text is in fixtures/posting-telus.txt
assertions: Produces a valid tailored .docx in the output directory (opens with python-docx, section headers and List Paragraph bullet styles intact)
No fabrication: every employer, title, date, metric, percentage, and named technology in the tailored resume traces to the master resume (rewording OK, new facts not)

Tailoring actually happened: summary and/or competencies reordered or reworded toward the posting's emphases (pre-sales scoping/estimation, Databricks/Snowflake lakehouse, MLOps/agentic AI) rather than a near-copy of the master
Ships a tailoring-notes.md with a keyword-coverage table mapping posting requirements to where the resume answers them, marking real gaps as gaps (e.g. Kubernetes/Docker depth, NLP)
Tailored resume length does not exceed the master (paragraph count <= master's 53)
No AI-slop or resume cliches introduced (leverage, robust, comprehensive, seamless, results-driven, proven track record, 'responsible for' as bullet opener)
